text:
I don't really know if you can recommend ARC cards to gamers at the moment. 
You do get a card that performs well, at least in DX 12 games. But as for all the other games that are based on an earlier / older graphics API, you invest in the hope / promise that the drivers will be optimized for them.
ARC cards require resizable bar. Which is not available on many older boards / CPUs.
The cards draw significantly more power compared to AMD / nVidia cards.
If you are shopping in the A380 price range, I would rather recommend an RX 6500 XT. It has 2GB less VRAM, but a much better performance.
Bottom line, for the time being, my graphics card underdog of choice is AMD and not Intel.
